title.en: Off-grid, is Diesel 50 the Electric 50 replacement?
title.zh: 无电网时，柴油50是电动50的替代吗？

description.en: Only as the diesel row in that output class: 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 150 m / 450 m. It does not inherit Electric 50’s three stone rows.
description.zh: 只是同一档输送量里的柴油行：99 kW、30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m。它不继承电动50的三行石子。

h1.en: Off-grid, is Diesel 50 the Electric 50 replacement?
h1.zh: 无电网时，柴油50是电动50的替代吗？

directAnswer.en: It is the diesel model to open in that class, not a copy of Electric 50. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 50 for sites without stable grid power: 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m and 3300 kg. Electric 50 is 55 kW, 26 m³/h, with fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm 60 m / 180 m. The selection guide places both on medium projects and tells you to match power type first.
directAnswer.zh: 它是这一档要打开的柴油型号，不是电动50的复印件。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油50印给电网不便的工地：6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m、3300 kg。电动50是 55 kW、26 m³/h，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 80 m / 240 m，24 mm 60 m / 180 m。选型指南把两台都放在中型项目上，并要求先对照动力。

heading.en: Do not transfer the 24 mm row
heading.zh: 不要把 24 mm 行搬过去

body.en: Electric 50 prints three stone distances. Diesel 50’s introduction pairs its single distance with 1 cm aggregate and the specification list has no maximum-aggregate cell. A 24 mm off-grid mix is not answered by silence. Ask Xingtai, or look at a diesel page that does print a coarse limit, such as LZ-80 at 6 cm and below, if the rest of that table also fits.
body.zh: 电动50印了三行石子距离。柴油50的介绍把唯一的距离和 1 cm 骨料写在一起，规格表没有最大骨料格。24 mm 的无电网料不能用空白来回答。问邢台，或者去看确实印了粗骨料上限的柴油页，例如 LZ-80 的 6 cm 及以下，前提是那张表的其余格子也对。

body.en: The outputs are different cells. Hopper volume is 0.4 m³ on both. That shared hopper does not merge the pumps. Weight is 3300 kg on Diesel 50 and 2800 kg on Electric 50.
body.zh: 输送量是不同的格子。料斗都是 0.4 m³。共用料斗不会把两台泵合并。柴油50重 3300 kg，电动50重 2800 kg。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Write “no grid” and the stone label you can document. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请写“无电网”，以及你能提供依据的石子标注。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 print a 13 mm row?
question.zh: 柴油50印了 13 mm 行吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel spraying machines are separate products with their own m³/h and hose cells.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油喷涂机是单独的产品，有自己的 m³/h 和软管格。

alt.zh: 邢台柴油50型混凝土泵，用于没有电动50所需电网时的浇筑
